root_cause.text: tb_xdomain_copy() unconditionally copies req->response_size bytes from the DMA pool buffer without verifying that the received frame size is at least that large, causing an out-of-bounds read into stale memory when a shorter response arrives.
root_cause.evidence: The patch limits the copy length to min(pkg->frame.size, req->response_size), and the commit description explicitly states: "copies req->response_size bytes from the received packet buffer regardless of the actual frame size. When a short response arrives, this reads past the valid frame data in the DMA pool buffer into stale contents from previous transactions."

intent_record.intent_summary: Protect against buffer over-read by copying only the minimum of the packet frame size and response buffer size.
intent_record.what: Replaced direct memcpy of req->response_size bytes with memcpy of min(pkg->frame.size, req->response_size) bytes.
intent_record.how: Prevents potential buffer over-read when pkg->buffer is smaller than req->response_size, ensuring only available data is copied.
